description: A DevOps engineer is reviewing application logs in the file located at /home/user/logs/app.log. Each line in the log file follows the format: [TIMESTAMP] [LEVEL] MESSAGE, for example [2024-06-12 15:32:54] [ERROR] Database connection failed. Your task is to extract all lines where the log level is ERROR and output them into a new file at /home/user/logs/error.log. The output file must preserve the full lines exactly as they appear in app.log, including the timestamp and message, and must only contain lines where [LEVEL] is exactly [ERROR]. After extracting, verify your results by printing the first three lines of /home/user/logs/error.log to the console. If there are fewer than three error lines, print all available lines.
